description: This PHP source file defines the Configuration class within the SuiteCRM\Utility namespace. It manages configuration settings for the SuiteCRM application, providing methods that implement the ArrayAccess interface to interact with configuration options, including retrieval, setting, existence check, and unsetting of configuration values.

classes.name: Configuration
classes.description: A class implementing ArrayAccess, providing interaction with application configuration stored in the container property.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Configuration object, requiring an external Configurator class to set up the configuration container.

methods.name: offsetSet
methods.description: Sets a configuration value for a given key, throwing exceptions if the key is missing or not found.

methods.name: offsetExists
methods.description: Checks if a configuration key exists in the container.

methods.name: offsetUnset
methods.description: Removes a configuration key from the container.

methods.name: offsetGet
methods.description: Retrieves a configuration value for a given key, returning null if it does not exist.
